test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two partners A and B started a business with the capitals of Rs. 12,000 and Rs. 18,000 respectively and made a profit of Rs. 1,800 at the end of the 1st year. Find the profit share of B.
solution:
**Given:**

Capital of A = Rs. 12,000

Capital of B = Rs. 18,000

Total Profit = Rs. 1,800

**Formula Used:**

Profit Share of a Partner = (Capital of the Partner / Total Capital) × Total Profit

**Calculation:**

Total Capital = 12,000 + 18,000 = 30,000

Profit Share of B = (Capital of B / Total Capital) × Total Profit

Profit Share of B = (18,000 / 30,000) × 1,800

Profit Share of B = (3)/(5) × 1,800

Profit Share of B = 3 × 360

Profit Share of B = 1,080

**The profit share of B is Rs. 1,080.**
